decisions.reason: This Requirement is explicitly scoped to the three-board variant. Adding an integrated-board variant without interboard connectors does not invalidate the connector layout retained for the separate-board design.
The sensor-board fit constraint remains valid for the existing separate sensor board; the source adds an integrated variant rather than removing the three-board variant.
The source proposes a separate integrated PCB design but does not change the existing task-local enclosure specification for the three-board device.
The mechanical constraints remain applicable to the separate power board in the retained three-board design. No integrated-board mechanical dimensions or placement rules are established.

The source does not explicitly change the ESP32 antenna placement rule or establish its scope for the integrated-board variant; retaining the same functionality alone does not entail a specific RF layout update.
The source does not explicitly state whether the reusable full-pin breakout must be carried into the cost-reduced integrated variant, and it leaves the existing main-board requirement unchanged.
The current dimensions and routing-space rules describe the existing main board. The source adds a distinct integrated-board variant without specifying its dimensions or routing constraints.
The four-layer rule remains applicable to the separate power board, while the source does not select a layer count or grounding arrangement for the integrated board.

A same-message MODIFY already records the integrated-board preference to use JLCPCB Basic components and extends the Requirement scope to the integrated-board variant; no additional correction is required.

This Requirement is scoped to interboard power in the three-board variant. The integrated variant needs no interboard interface, but the source does not remove or alter the retained three-board interface.

This Requirement remains valid for interboard signals in the three-board variant. The new integrated variant eliminates such connectors only within that variant and does not modify the existing interface.
The source establishes a component-selection preference for the proposed integrated board but does not request or modify assembly-ready BOM deliverables or part-number requirements.
